_about: Made-up statutory figures for tests/web/combochange.test.cjs, in $M, added to combination_figures.json so the change on our company can be checked against hand-worked numbers: realized gains go down (40 to 28, down 30.0%), cash and invested assets start from zero on our side (a percent change from zero means nothing), cash and short-term investments barely move (2,000 to 2,000.5, up 0.025%, which rounds to 0.0%). Keyed by NAIC code as there. No real company, code or figure.
